voice.name: The Neighbor
voice.instruct: female, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent

lines.text: A fund wants to buy a large block, quietly.
First, a risk officer approves a mandate: the dealers, the size, the maximum price.
The agent cannot trade past it. The ledger says no.
Two dealers quote blind. Neither sees the other's price.
The lowest price wins, by a rule anyone can check.
Securities and cash move together, in one transaction, or not at all.
Every number on screen comes from the ledger.
Shadow Desk. Approve. Quote. Award. Settle. Private execution, on Canton.
